{{Sexagenary cycle}}

'''Yin Water Rabbit''' (癸卯, ''mizunoto usagi''; onyomi ''kibō'') is the 40th of the sixty combinations of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|en|Sexagenary cycle|qid=Q246658|lt=Sexagenary cycle}}.

It is the 40th of the sixty stem-branch combinations, preceded by {{ill|Yang Water Tiger|ja|壬寅}} and followed by {{ill|Yang Wood Dragon|ja|甲辰}}. The {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem}} ''癸'' is Yin Water, and the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branch}} ''卯'' (Rabbit) is Yin Wood; together they form a Mutual Generation relationship in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qid=Q218652|lt=Wuxing}}.

==Pronunciation==
* English: Yin Water Rabbit (癸卯)
** Chinese (Mandarin Pinyin): guǐmǎo
** Cantonese (Jyutping): gwai2 maau5
** Japanese:
*** Kun'yomi: mizunoto-usagi
*** On'yomi: kibō
** Korean (Revised Romanization, Hangul): gye-myo (계묘)
** Vietnamese (Hán-Việt): Quý Mão

==Years of Yin Water Rabbit==
A {{ill|Common Era|en|Common Era|qid=Q208141|lt=Common Era}} year that leaves a remainder of 43 when divided by 60 is a year of Yin Water Rabbit (癸卯).

==Months of Yin Water Rabbit==
In years where the last digit is 2 or 7 (corresponding to the {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem}} {{ill|Mizunoe (壬)|ja|壬|lt=Mizunoe (壬)|2=ja|3=壬|4=zh|5=壬|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren}} or {{ill|Hinoto (丁)|ja|丁|lt=Hinoto (丁)|2=ja|3=丁|4=zh|5=丁|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ding}}), the {{ill|February|en|February|qid=Q109|lt=February}} of that year is considered a Yin Water Rabbit month. However, this applies to the {{ill|Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|ja|旧暦|11=Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Lunisolar calendar}}, and in some cases, the {{ill|Solar term|en|Solar term|qid=Q1190993|lt=Solar term}} (from {{ill|Jingzhe|en|Jingzhe|qid=Q1306596|lt=Jingzhe}} to the day before {{ill|Qingming (solar term)|en|Qingming (solar term)|qid=Q1680269|lt=Qingming}}) is used.

==Days of Yin Water Rabbit==
=== Selection Days ===
Yin Water Rabbit days are the 11th day of the {{ill|Tenitsu-shin|ja|天一天上|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ten'ichi Tenjō|ja_comment=天一神|2=ja|3=天一神|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11442153}} cycle.
